svg.aria-label: Penny architecture, animated: request flows from the phone client through FastAPI to the LangGraph runtime, which calls Claude and dispatches tools into the application layer and the enriched transaction repository, streaming components back to the client
svg.title: Penny — architecture, end to end
svg.text: Hexagonal layering: dependencies point inward, so the domain and application layers know nothing of FastAPI, LangGraph or Anthropic. Colour marks the concern; the panel label names the layer.

The dots trace one real turn — two model calls, one tool call. Badges give the call order 1 to 12, where a and b are the outbound and return halves of one call. The two model edges are travelled twice each, so they carry two numbers: 4a·9a out and 4b·9b back — the first pass chooses a tool, the second writes the answer once the figures return.
O1 to O5 is the offline enrichment pipeline, which ran once before the app was ever started. W is wiring, not data flow.
web/ — vanilla JS, no build step
CSS phone frame: notch, home indicator
